verdict.rationale: Slack documents a public Web API for querying and changing workspace state, with more than 200 methods. Per-method reference docs such as chat.postMessage, official SDKs, an official OpenAPI spec for the Web API, a dated deprecation changelog, and a machine-readable llms.txt make it well suited to programmatic and agent-driven use. The 404 probe at docs-site OpenAPI paths does not contradict the spec published in the official GitHub repo. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
